# Supportivekoala

Supportivekoala is a platform that automates image generation using customizable templates, enabling users to create visual content programmatically through API integration.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/supportivekoala/.

## Actions

- **Create Image**: Create a new image based on a template.
- **Create Template**: Create a new template for image generation.
- **List Images** (read-only): List images associated with the authenticated user.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Retrieve all templates.
- **Register User**: Register a new user account.
- **Retrieve Template by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a template by id.
